title: Ampleness on algebraic spaces is etale local on the base
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $f:F\to Y$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $M$ be a line module on $F$. On a scheme $Z$, a line module on its small etale site is identified with an ordinary invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] via the equivalence between quasi-coherent modules on the Zariski and small etale sites of $Z$; ampleness of a line module on a scheme means ampleness of this invertible module. Suppose $\{g_i:Y_i\to Y\}_{i\in I}$ is a jointly surjective family of etale maps with each $Y_i$ a scheme. Assume $F_i=F\times_YY_i$ is a scheme for every $i$, and let $M_i$ be the pullback of $M$ along the etale map $F_i\to F$. Assume that for every affine open $W\subseteq Y_i$ the restriction of $M_i$ to $F_i\times_{Y_i}W$ is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Then $f$ is representable: for every scheme $T$ and every map $h_T\to Y$, the fibre product $F\times_YT$ is a scheme. Moreover, for every scheme $T$ with an etale map $h_T\to Y$ and every affine open $W\subseteq T$, the pullback of $M$ along the etale map $F\times_YW\to F$ is ample. In particular, if $Y$ is a scheme, then $F$ is a scheme, and the restriction of $M$ to $f^{-1}(W)$ is ample for every affine open $W\subseteq Y$.

lean.statement:
theorem representable_and_ample_of_etale_cover
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {F Y : AlgebraicSpace S} (f : F ⟶ Y)
    (M : F.Modules) (hM : F.IsLineModule M)
    (I : Type v) (Yᵢ : I → Y.EtaleSite) (Xᵢ : I → F.EtaleSite)
    (pᵢ : ∀ i : I, (Xᵢ i).obj.left ⟶ (Yᵢ i).obj.left)
    (hcover : ∀ (T : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y.obj.obj),
      Sieve.generate (fun (U : Over S) (k : U ⟶ T) ↦
        ∃ (i : I) (b : U ⟶ (Yᵢ i).obj.left),
          yoneda.map k ≫ a = yoneda.map b ≫ (Yᵢ i).obj.hom) ∈
            (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) T)
    (hpb : ∀ i : I, IsPullback (Xᵢ i).obj.hom (yoneda.map (pᵢ i))
      f.hom.hom (Yᵢ i).obj.hom)
    (hample : ∀ (i : I) (W : (Y.etaleForget.obj (Yᵢ i)).Opens), IsAffineOpen W →
      ∃ hL : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (((pᵢ i).left ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι)).obj
          ((F.schemeRestriction (Xᵢ i)).obj M)).IsInvertible,
        @Scheme.Modules.IsAmple ((pᵢ i).left ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (((pᵢ i).left ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι)).obj
            ((F.schemeRestriction (Xᵢ i)).obj M)) hL) :
    IsRepresentable f.hom.hom ∧
      ∀ T : Y.EtaleSite, ∃ (X : F.EtaleSite) (p : X.obj.left ⟶ T.obj.left),
        IsPullback X.obj.hom (yoneda.map p) f.hom.hom T.obj.hom ∧
          ∀ W : (Y.etaleForget.obj T).Opens, IsAffineOpen W →
            ∃ hL : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((p.left ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι)).obj
                ((F.schemeRestriction X).obj M)).IsInvertible,
              @Scheme.Modules.IsAmple (p.left ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme
                ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((p.left ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι)).obj
                  ((F.schemeRestriction X).obj M)) hL
